ways to make it a proof, both used on ajc-fbc r3 (`eed54636d`) and both stronger

claim about my own edit into a claim about the kernel's view of the term.

variant alongside the endpoint — it doubles as the instrument a later session uses
to verify closing the leaf (its line turns clean with no other edit). Keep the
old two-leaf line as the comparison point rather than deleting it; a single
`sorryAx` line proves nothing without its pair. Related:
